item.title: Confessional 1.46.0
item.description:
• Resize the assistant: drag the line between a meeting and the assistant (double-click for the usual width).
  • Your AI stays where you put it: Confessional no longer switches to Claude by itself when Claude Code appears on your Mac; existing Claude users are unchanged.
  • AI on this Mac: its model shows first in Settings, and messages no longer point you to Claude.

item.title: Confessional 1.45.0
item.description:
• Use your ChatGPT plan (Plus or Pro) for summaries, chat and screenshots, through Codex, with its tools switched off.
  • Use in Other Apps: connect your meetings to the Claude app, Claude Code (one click) and Codex.
  • Plainer words in Settings: AI Models lists your plans, a model on this Mac, then API keys; “Deep answer” in chat; models on this Mac named Small to Largest.

item.title: Confessional 1.44.0
item.description: • Agent mode can open web pages you link in a private built-in browser: read them, see them, click, type and scroll (no sign-ins; only the sites you linked; nothing else on the page loads from elsewhere)

item.title: Confessional 1.43.0
item.description:
• Screenshots from videos: transcribing a video file or a video link now picks slides and screens like a call (link sheet: Screenshots from the video)
  • Saving a chat answer as a Word document keeps its web sources (numbered, with addresses) and writes meeting citations out as the meeting and time; Copy and Email do the same

item.title: Confessional 1.42.0
item.description:
• A new first-run setup that explains itself: how it works, what each permission is for, how summaries are written, and a test that runs a real recording
  • Getting Started checklist on Home and a Getting Started guide (menu → More)
  • Tidier transcripts: mm-hmms said over someone else and lone ums are left out of the reading view; quiet background voices from the other side's room are dropped
  • Screen text no longer turns into headings in transcript files; face-only screenshots are hidden (with the images add-on)
  • On-Mac summaries keep action item owners; screenshots are described two at a time on this Mac

item.title: Confessional 1.41.0
item.description:
• Fixes Confessional quitting when you press Record on some Macs (a mic that changes as the call starts, like AirPods switching to call mode)
  • On 8 GB Macs, earlier meetings and imports wait to be transcribed until the call ends
  • If Confessional quits unexpectedly, it offers to send the crash report next time
  • The calendar fits small screens
  • Settings → AI Models → Claude: set up Claude Code in three steps

item.title: Confessional 1.40.0
item.description:
• Agent mode for Claude Code chats: it searches your meetings and the web itself, uses helpers, and keeps one session per conversation
  • Claude (and other AI apps) can now read long meetings in full, part by part

item.title: Confessional 1.39.0
item.description:
• Mic and call waveforms either side of the stop button
  • The assistant beside a meeting (⌘J)
  • Coloured initials for each speaker, with talk time
  • Answers show what they read; citations are ▶ 12:34 buttons
  • Processing steps at a glance, with the kind of notes you can change

item.title: Confessional 1.38.0
item.description:
• ⌃⌥N: a quick note over any app while recording
  • Transcribe from a link (YouTube, Vimeo, podcasts and more)
  • Call bar: What to say? and What to ask? next to Catch me up
  • AGENTS.md in the meetings folder for Claude Code, Codex and Cursor

item.title: Confessional 1.37.0
item.description:
• Notes are written in the meeting's language
  • Stand-ups, 1:1s, client calls, interviews, planning, retros and webinars get their own notes section
  • Settings → Files & Storage: see, remove and move downloaded models
  • Join two recordings of one meeting
  • Background music stays out of call audio; disconnect your calendar in Settings
  • Fixed: Analytics connections the AI rejected could come back
